dedupe_keys.name: energy distribution models with ami smart meter sensor dataset

description: Energy distribution models with AMI smart meter sensor dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Johannes Maree. Presented is an anonymized processed dataset, representative of a medium-, and low-voltage energy distribution network, in the vicinity of Porsgrunn, Norway, with supplementary sensor data. The energy distribution network data has been obtained from the regional Distributed System Operator (DSO) network owner in an exported Common Grid Model Exchange Specification (CGMES) unstructured data format. Coverage: national (NO); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
